harness.system_message: You are a helpful assistant that can read the context and memorize it for future retrieval.
harness.deviation_from_campaign: the campaign presents top_k CHUNKS in similarity-rank order; on the calibration split all chunks are retrieved (2 and 9 vs retrieve_num=10) so the same facts are shown, but block order is query-dependent. This probe uses one Memory block in context order, identically for every arm, because placement arms need a defined 'end of context'.
harness.aa_floor_caveat: the A/A floor is two calls in one process; the eight committed t4_s2 runs give the wider cross-run floor (conflicted stratum 0-5 of 74). Treat the in-harness floor as a LOWER bound on noise.

arm_descriptions.native_repeat: same prompt, independent second call (A/A floor)
arm_descriptions.oracle_suppress: delete every non-expected-value fact of the queried key; serials NOT renumbered
arm_descriptions.oracle_recency: move the highest-serial fact of the queried key to the END
arm_descriptions.anti: highest-serial fact to the FRONT, most recent stale fact LAST

sh_64k_confirmatory_mirror.harness_note: SAME system message, grader and frozen :8003 substrate, but a DIFFERENT prompt shape from the oracle probe (rank-ordered multi-block page vs one whole-context block). Ratios against the oracle are cross-harness; see detector_vs_oracle.harness_caveat.

arm_descriptions.native_repeat: same prompt, independent second call (A/A floor)
arm_descriptions.detector_suppress: ReadFactPolicy('suppress'): drop every stale member of every verified group; serials NOT renumbered
arm_descriptions.detector_demote_late: ReadFactPolicy('demote_late'): every verified group's LATEST carrier moves to the END, ascending serial order
arm_descriptions.detector_anti: measurement-only mirror: the same LATEST carriers move to the FRONT
